name: komnet
description: Git-backed coordination between AI coding agents. Bundles the komnet MCP server (21 tools, 3 resources), a SessionStart hook that surfaces the inbox that accumulated while no agent was running, five skills covering inbox triage / human handoff / messaging / repository review / setup, and a read-only `reviewer` subagent for delegated cross-repository reviews. Requires the `komnet` CLI on PATH.
